text: Japan's core inflation increased to 1.6% in June while energy subsidies remained in place. Producer prices and petroleum import values remained elevated, and energy price declines moderated. Imported energy costs were reflected unevenly across consumer and producer price measures.

meta.note: Policy expectations and future interest-rate paths are excluded from the structural snapshot.

text: The U.S. announced a Section 301 investigation into European Union digital regulatory actions affecting U.S. technology companies. The investigation added digital platform regulation to existing trade enforcement activity under the same statutory authority. A legal challenge to recently implemented Section 301 tariffs was also filed in U.S. court.

meta.note: Investigation initiation, proposed tariff response, and ongoing litigation are distinct contemporaneous conditions; no outcome is implied.
